On a locale-only receipt redraw, keep focus on any surviving control. Restore only a previously focused node that was removed, and only while focus remains on the body. Source/company actions must match both role and the complete destination after the existing navigation rewrite. A changed or missing action falls back to that receipt’s summary; an absent, changed or ambiguous record uses the current focusable topic heading. gmi_return carries only the qualified theme/company catalogue context, a bounded query and at most one upstream theme return; it does not capture an immutable source snapshot, exact opener or scroll. For a separately admitted route, a missing qualified bridge reaches the existing 15-second failure boundary with Retry / Open original; a registry mismatch uses refresh. Neither proves withdrawal. Access restrictions, missing files and routing eligibility need distinct evidence.
Future recovery belongs to the existing serving/shell owner, must retain only permitted return context and cannot depend on JavaScript in a deleted document. Qualified against Macro @071ed19f and Terminal @4e868da4. Installed flags, live responses and the separately held registry proposal remain unverified.

Both GMI stylesheets retain a 44 px minimum for native summaries. The production macro renders Theme details / 主题详情 separately from Source receipt / 来源凭证, including without JavaScript. One attempt captures the complete normalized URL and selected theme. Pending shows Copying… / 正在复制…. Success, failure and finally may update only that same current attempt. Selection, filter URL changes, history, lens changes and page exit retire it, even after an A→B→A return. A current failure shows the captured URL in the existing manual fallback. Later focus, pointer intent or window blur relinquishes automatic focus; body focus alone grants nothing. pr_description.body:
## Why

GMI previously led with taxonomy and admission machinery, leaving readers to infer what a theme meant, what a company connection established, and which source date or lifecycle qualified the claim. This implements the Chairman's resumed product-and-code mandate in the existing frontend and consolidates Paper into one canonical product system.

## What changes

- Lead theme research with a plain-language topic explanation, dated company/product evidence, explicit limits and a concrete next action.
- Add the searchable company-evidence route. Preserve all 371 microthemes, parent paths, Core/Extended and evidence filters, the full index, taxonomy tree, value-chain lens and coverage arithmetic.
- Preserve URL/history restoration, responsive mobile browsing, related-topic navigation, keyboard/focus behavior, copy success/denial handling and server-rendered/no-JS/malformed-payload fallbacks.
- Reuse the existing theme, language, navigation and Brain owners. The original Brain root retains its palette, events and focus lifecycle; styling uses canonical tokens.
- Restrict public product rendering to the single separately cleared Micron observation, whose source was published on 26 February 2024, including its receipt, planned lifecycle, product/platform, source identity and visible EN/ZH attribution. ACCEPT/RATIFIED alone does not admit a new public fact.
- Exclude private graph/correction/raw-source context from Jinja, retire stale issuer output after withdrawal and refuse nonregular/symlink issuer targets.
- Preserve missing, unknown or malformed knowledge dates as not recorded in EN/ZH; source publication and Planned lifecycle remain independent. Valid recorded first-seen dates retain their existing display.
- Include generated pages, incumbent GMI CI registration, production-render regression tests, dated browser evidence and editable Paper workflow/build views.
- Bring the full index directly to search with one title/date, a 44 px Clear search action, coherent filtered counts, and a mobile Category + Go control that preserves research context and repeat navigation.
- Bring company evidence to search sooner, distinguish matching counts from catalogue coverage, and recover keyboard focus before results disappear.
- Retire expired qualified returns without losing owned focus, and provide direct company-evidence recovery from the relationship publication state.

The canonical design home is [GMI Explorer · Product system](https://app.paper.design/file/01M5H6EARN9YHQV17JC6ZG9BRY/p-1-0). Start index work on [Index · Search and navigation](https://app.paper.design/file/01M5H6EARN9YHQV17JC6ZG9BRY/p-8-0); [Companies · Evidence and recovery](https://app.paper.design/file/01M5H6EARN9YHQV17JC6ZG9BRY/p-9-0) covers the company workflow; [Relationships · Availability](https://app.paper.design/file/01M5H6EARN9YHQV17JC6ZG9BRY/p-A-0) covers publication-state recovery; the [source receipt page and 16-module Build](https://app.paper.design/file/01M5H6EARN9YHQV17JC6ZG9BRY/p-7-0) carry the current interaction/source contracts. Original product views and historical references remain preserved; the dated ten-board evidence below describes the earlier product set.

## Current source and focused verification — 9 November 2026

Current head: [`ed2a0d178b459a8bdb1cc233f257ee82d946f71a`](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/Macro/commit/ed2a0d178b459a8bdb1cc233f257ee82d946f71a). The PR remains **Draft and unmerged**, with the release/model holds below unchanged.

The latest change repairs qualified return retirement and clarifies relationship availability. When a Back link's context disappears, its existing owner moves only owned focus to the real brand link, with an existing navigation link as a bounded fallback, before removing the holder. Valid return anchors retain identity; unrelated focus, URL/history, locale and the existing destination projection remain unchanged.

Relationships now uses the compact **Company relationships / 公司关系** task header. **Public relationship view unavailable / 暂无公开关系视图** describes the missing verified public projection without inferring every record's clearance status. **Browse company evidence / 浏览公司证据** is the native primary recovery action; Explore themes, Coverage & methodology and the original publication explanation/disclosure remain available. The existing navigation owner preserves a qualified company search and upstream research return. No relationship data is added or exposed.

| Evidence | Exact scope |
|---|---|
| Latest return/relationship matrix | **28 cases / 28 fresh anonymous contexts**, Chrome157.0.8103.39, zero page errors: eight header scenarios, twelve return-focus paths across six routes in EN/ZH, two actual company/research journeys, four actually without JavaScript and two existing company focus/count regressions |
| Interaction and layout | Absent/rejected/valid returns, anchor identity, locale, unrelated focus, real back/forward, hidden/missing brand fallback and focus-handler redirect; **24 matched layouts**, with **145.98–196.39 px** less space before the publication panel; six final captures inspected |
| Production renderer and source | 48 checked inputs and the existing accepted e644fa48… model; all nine parent outputs reproduced; final rendered changes limited to relationships HTML and paired JS; all six other HTML pages and CSS byte-identical; all nine changed files published and read back exactly |
| Earlier company entry at `49d47033` | 29 cases, 44 matched layouts, 145.98–215.14 px less space before search; matching-company versus on-file counts, focus-before-hide and distinct genuine-empty catalogue fixture |
| Earlier category navigation at `9bdc486c` | 24 cases: pending native select + explicit Go, retained anchors, typeahead, repeat navigation, empty categories, filtering/locale, stale targets and responsive focus; desktop/no-JS native links retained |
| Earlier index header / Clear | Header at `20179e31`: 23 cases/66 layouts. Clear at `16a87f43`: 36 cases/42 contexts. Each result remains bound to its recorded source |
| Paper readback | EN390 Day availability, ZH320 Noir catalogue return and an expanded publication disclosure. Build now has **16 modules / 51 nodes**. Prior company views and all 48 old Build node IDs/styles/parents remain exact outside four intentional source/proof text updates |

Read [DESIGN_RECORD §§11.19–11.31](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/Macro/blob/ed2a0d178b459a8bdb1cc233f257ee82d946f71a/research/theme_graph/gmi_design_20261021/DESIGN_RECORD.md), [return/relationship validation](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/Macro/blob/ed2a0d178b459a8bdb1cc233f257ee82d946f71a/research/theme_graph/gmi_design_20261021/RETURN_RECOVERY_VALIDATION_20261109.json), [company validation](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/Macro/blob/49d47033f4d758af2ec7212fccee04d762fec956/research/theme_graph/gmi_design_20261021/COMPANY_ENTRY_VALIDATION_20261109.json) and [category validation](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/Macro/blob/9bdc486c6b7622d9f306d29e9d12d572ed88415c/research/theme_graph/gmi_design_20261021/CATEGORY_PICKER_VALIDATION_20261109.json).

The baseline retains two expected focused-holder failures. Preserved test diagnostics separate a nested fixture-serialization correction from product behavior, and native focus-time scroll from later layout anchoring: **300 before focus → 300 after focus → 240 after removal**. The final verifier checks focus's own effect; no new scroll controller is added. An exceptional fixture with no usable focus target still removes the invalid return and is not reported as successful focus recovery.

These are exact-source rendering and anonymous component results. Brain/stale/missing-header fixtures are explicit. No current-head hosted CI, OS-native select popup, spoken assistive-technology, full shared shell/fonts, shared Brain runtime, live-account, public-admission or deployment acceptance is claimed.

## Release blocker — keep draft

**Keep Draft and all no-merge/no-Ready/no-un-draft/no-enqueue/no-relabel holds. No auto-merge or deployment is authorized while these holds remain.**

Original model run `gmi-product-upgrade-20261103-model01` remains **EFFECT_UNKNOWN / ROOT_UNVERIFIED**, with root `gmi-paper-makeover-20261103-sol`, parent `gmi-product-upgrade-20261103-sol`, original controller PID `38742` and lease `868f3981b9bd`. Its current status denies result consumption, retry and dispatch. No applicable settlement action is exposed; the original installed runtime owner must reconcile this same run/process/lease and publish eligible terminal evidence. This continuation has not consumed its result, reassigned its work or modified its fenced model/presentation/test paths.

The current product specimen does not grant broader source-emission rights, qualification, internal graph use or relationship publication. A qualified public-data projection remains with the incumbent owner. Release also requires concluded current-head CI and the protected deployment/live-verification path. The existing hourly observer reports attention facts only; it is not an engineering worker or release authority.
